name: Pipeline average
pitch: Calculate the average deal size from the last three deals in your pipeline.
instructions: Read the pipeline file. Extract the three most recent deal sizes. Add them together. Divide the total by three. Show the result in a table. If fewer than three deals are found, list what is there and say how many deals were found. If the file cannot be read, say so and stop. Do not invent numbers.
readme:
# Pipeline average

Calculate the average deal size from the last three deals in your pipeline.

**What it needs**: reads a pipeline file on the computer. No internet access, no calendar, no mail.

**What it will not do**: it cannot browse the web, send email, or look up deals in a CRM app. It only works with the pipeline file that is already on the computer.
